√vid2 'find'
present: [6.] vindáti vindáte etc. V.+ -- [2.] vitté etc. vidé (3s.) vidré vidām (3s.) vidāná vídāna vindate (3p.) vindyāt? 
perfect: vivéda vividus etc. V.+ vivéditha vividat vividé etc. 
aorist: [1.] avedi védi -- [2.] ávidat ávidata etc. vidā́si etc. vidā́t etc. vidét videta etc. videṣṭa -- [3.] avīvidat -- [4.] avitsi 
future: [1.] vetsyati vetsyate etc. B.+ vediṣyati -- [2.] vettā 
verbal: vittá V.+ vinna AV.+ vettum ve/ttave ve/ttavai? ve/ttos vittvā́ -vídya B.+ vidé 
secondary: passive: vidyáte etc. V.+ vidyáti etc. -- intensive: vévidat vévidāna etc. -- desiderative: vivitsati etc. B.+ -- causative: vedayati etc. 
derivatives: -vid V.+ -vídya V. -véda V.+ -vedaka C. -vedin C. vedya B.+ védana V.+ -vedanīya C. védas V.+ véduka B. vitti AV.+ -vettavya C. -vettṛ E.+ védiṣṭha RV. védīyas RV. vidā́yya RV. -vinda B.+ -vindu V.B. -vindaka C. -vivitsu? E. 
Doubtless originally the same with the preceding root. In some of their meanings, the two are so close together as hardly to be separable; and there are instances, from the Veda down, of exchanges of forms between them.
